body:
There are a seperate type of locks, identified by LOCKTAG that we don't use in YB, so function calls have been disabled. Unfortunately, the LWLockReleaseAll function was accidentally disabled as well.

Fix: 
```diff
diff --git a/src/postgres/src/backend/access/transam/xact.c b/src/postgres/src/backend/access/transam/xact.c
index 138dc4002f..3fe664da7d 100644
--- a/src/postgres/src/backend/access/transam/xact.c
+++ b/src/postgres/src/backend/access/transam/xact.c
@@ -2691,15 +2691,13 @@ AbortTransaction(void)
        AtAbort_Memory();
        AtAbort_ResourceOwner();
​
-       if (YBIsPgLockingEnabled()) {
-               /*
-               * Release any LW locks we might be holding as quickly as possible.
-               * (Regular locks, however, must be held till we finish aborting.)
-               * Releasing LW locks is critical since we might try to grab them again
-               * while cleaning up!
-               */
-               LWLockReleaseAll();
-       }
+       /*
+        * Release any LW locks we might be holding as quickly as possible.
+        * (Regular locks, however, must be held till we finish aborting.)
+        * Releasing LW locks is critical since we might try to grab them again
+        * while cleaning up!
+        */
+       LWLockReleaseAll();
​
        /* Clear wait information and command progress indicator */
        pgstat_report_wait_end();
```

rename.from: [YSQL] Deadlock on duplicate replication slot names
rename.to: [YSQL] YB does not release LWLocks on AbortTransaction

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-7074](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-7074)
### Description

They were observed in YB 2.16.2 on YBM hosts. The PG master process has died while connection processes are stuck without termination. Stack trace are as followed:

```
Executable module set to "/home/yugabyte/yb-software/yugabyte-2.16.2.1130-b1-centos-x86_64/postgres/bin/postgres".
Architecture set to: x86_64--linux-gnu.
(lldb) bt 20
* thread #1: tid = 28386, 0x00007f7fa854918a libpthread.so.0`do_futex_wait + 43 at futex-internal.h:205, name = 'postgres', stop reason = trace
  * frame #0: 0x00007f7fa854918a libpthread.so.0`do_futex_wait + 43 at futex-internal.h:205
    frame #1: 0x00007f7fa854915f libpthread.so.0`do_futex_wait(sem=0x00007f7f99d4d238, abstime=0x0000000000000000) + 15 at sem_waitcommon.c:111
    frame #2: 0x00007f7fa8549231 libpthread.so.0`__new_sem_wait_slow(sem=0x00007f7f99d4d238, abstime=0x0000000000000000) + 81 at sem_waitcommon.c:181
    frame #3: 0x0000564e5c911438 postgres`LWLockAcquire + 408
    frame #4: 0x0000564e5cabd524 postgres`write_relcache_init_file + 1188
    frame #5: 0x0000564e5cabcbd5 postgres`RelationCacheInitializePhase3 + 1349
    frame #6: 0x0000564e5cae9cce postgres`InitPostgres + 5086
    frame #7: 0x0000564e5c92a3e8 postgres`PostgresMain + 1864
    frame #8: 0x0000564e5c873766 postgres`BackendRun + 566
    frame #9: 0x0000564e5c872b62 postgres`ServerLoop + 5538
    frame #10: 0x0000564e5c86e1f6 postgres`PostmasterMain + 5574
    frame #11: 0x0000564e5c77229a postgres`PostgresServerProcessMain + 2202
    frame #12: 0x0000564e5c464cf2 postgres`main + 34
    frame #13: 0x00007f7fa7bb9825 libc.so.6`__libc_start_main(main=0x0000564e5c464cd0, argc=23, argv=0x00007ffcdee82f78, init=<unavailable>, fini=<unavailable>, rtld_fini=<unavailable>, stack_end=0x00007ffcdee82f68) + 245 at libc-start.c:289
```

Sampled two processes and both of them are stuck at acquiring the locks during writing relcache init files. Likely, there is a dead-lock case so they were never able to move on.

This is a direct cause to "tserver stuck at restarting PG in a infinite loop without properly cleaning up old hung PG processes". (#17622)
